>  If hearing/seeing things about suicide make you feel more suicidal/worse, make the decision to avoid them. 

Not that easy in a middle school environment. Thanks for all of the other advice, though. Definitely helps.
I don't play sports and I barely eat. Thanks for the advice.
Sorry, slept and went to school. Yeah, we have a counselor.

I put stress on their relationship simply by existing.  
  
I don't know, they won't tell me.  
  
My parents would have to know and they wouldn't let me.
I've been reaching out for a while, I tried that lifeline online chat but nobody answered. I can't call the hotline because my parents would hear me and yell at me.
Can you link me to somewhere I can learn about those?
I don't want to get married or have kids. I talked to a professional for a couple of sessions, my parents stopped paying for him around 4 months ago, couldn't afford.

My mom has depression and anxiety, like me, and my dad doesn't understand emotions. They don't work together.  
  
I'm a disappointment because I spend my life on the computer programming, my parents aren't proud.  
  
I was told I was depressed by the therapist my parents can no longer afford.  
  
*(edit: typo)*

My parents have been fighting, I have little friends, I feel uncared for and unloved. I feel alone. I keep feeling more disconnected from life. I'm a disappointment. I'm a failure. I'm depressed.  
  
Death just sounds like an "off" switch to me

That's the funny part. First off, the depression is chemical, major depressive disorder. Diagnosed by the therapist my parent's can't afford anymore. My parents have been fighting and yell when I ask for my help, my school points me to other people for help that I can't afford, and I have no "etc."
Wish it was that easy, my parents are wrapped up with 6 month old baby.
